versions.v0.8: Actual v8 STL float32 coordinates, verified facet-by-facet against supplied indexed candidate geometry

measurement: First head-shell ray hit from X=±60 toward X=0; no cap or hardware union. Exact indexed triangle provenance recovered with Manifold output face_id mapping.
primary_metrics: Signed midpoint sagitta on Y4..12; positive tangent reverse-turn on Y5..11 after a cubic Savitzky-Golay derivative on a 2 mm window.
whole_profile_peak_screen: Y−5..18, excluding any hit triangle incident to a visible original ear vertex and all samples within 0.5 mm of or behind the cap plane. Peaks use 0.10 mm prominence and 0.75 mm half-prominence width as diagnostic noise cutoffs, not design pass criteria. One broad cranium maximum is allowed; extra peaks plus reverse turns suggest a local bump.
limits: Original ear exclusions use the existing provenance mask, including the v7 rear-ear micro-refinement vertices.
A failed peak-count threshold alone does not prove a bad shape; source constraints and the plotted curves must be considered.
Surface/assembly/printing validators are not run here.
Positive bow and zero reverse turn apply to the common Y4..12 core only. Wider original-face/ear-root transitions retain measurable S-shaped inflections.
The all-height top projection, including the source ear silhouette, is separately measured in top-silhouette-review.json.
